summary: Full-stack regression for Grail Break clone (both backend + frontend). Backend: all 13 pytest tests PASS (relay/assets, auth email+wallet, pull engine, sellback, odds distribution, breaks join/create, battle full cycle). Frontend: all 10 routes render with live data (/, /gacha, /breaks, /hits, /how, /battle, /live, /graildex, /build, /me). Sign-in modal + auth-switch + registration (gives $250) → nav-balance chip shows $250.00. Gacha pull end-to-end verified: pull-gb-poke-25 → rip-stage fullscreen overlay → video (foil_bronze.webm, readyState 4, currentTime advancing) → rip-result reveal at ~25s showing card name/value (e.g. 'Persian · $24 COMMON', 'Sudowoodo · $18 COMMON') → rip-keep debits $25 (balance $250→$225). Sell-back flow reached rip-sellback and clicked successfully. Breaks: cards use data-testid='break-{id}', clicking opens break-detail modal with seat-grid (20 seats visible) + proof-of-fair ('cheapest pack first, grand prize opens last'). Graildex renders 39 card images. Mobile 375px: mobile-tabs shows exactly Lobby/Breaks/Gacha/Build a break/More, gacha machines 2-per-row (x=35 & x=210), tab navigation works. 768px and 1366px render fine. Branding scan passed — no 'Loom', 'Weft', 'MakeMarkets', 'Hyperliquid' anywhere in UI.

issues: React hydration warning: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>'. In Battle.jsx line 81, the <option> for players select wraps dynamic text in a <span>. Browsers strip the inner <span> which causes hydration mismatch. Fix: render the number directly inside <option> without a span wrapper (e.g. <option value={n} key={n}>{n} players</option>).

action_items: Minor: Fix <span> inside <option> in /app/frontend/src/pages/Battle.jsx (hydration warning only — no functional impact).
critical_code_review_comments: Battle.jsx player count <select> wraps option children in an auto-injected <span> (likely from a dev-time instrumentation layer injecting x-* attrs). Harmless at runtime but logs a React hydration warning on every /battle render.

Breaks list uses clickable div cards (data-testid='break-*') that open an in-page modal rather than a real route — fine as a design choice, but note: no deep-linkable URL per break (e.g. /breaks/:id).

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend fully green (13/13). RipStage portal + VP9/Vorbis transcode fallback working: reveal ~25s. Breaks list shows 7 real + 5 local 'Test Night Break' seeded entries — those stale test seeds can be ignored or pruned. Mobile tabs + 2-per-row gacha confirmed. Only remaining dev-console noise is a <span>-in-<option> hydration warning on /battle.
rca of the issue: N/A — no functional bugs. The /battle hydration warning stems from Battle.jsx:81 where option children are wrapped by a <span> (injected by the x-source instrumentation). HTML parser disallows <span> inside <option>, so React warns on hydration. Mitigation: ensure option label is a plain string/number expression, not wrapped by any dynamic span.
